wordmark.purpose: "imgstrip", lowercase, beside the brand mark in the bar.

title.purpose: The well and gate headline; the largest type in the system.

body-sm.purpose: Running text: well sub line, notes, limits, reveals and item rows, checks, footer summary.

control.purpose: Button labels, file names, switch labels, the list count.

heading.purpose: Group titles inside a file's detail.

label.purpose: Field labels and the row status.

caption.purpose: File sub lines, meta lines, hints, formats line, colophon.

mono.purpose: Real values only: metadata fields, coordinates, byte counts, paths.

mono-hash.purpose: SHA-256 lines in the verified panel and the seal tooltip.

_figures.purpose: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on counts (count pill, list count, group counts, footer summary); sizes and dimensions stay proportional.

_source.purpose: Schibsted Grotesk variable woff2 (400-900), latin + latin-ext subsets, self-hosted in src/imgstrip/web/static/fonts/ under the OFL; font-display: swap; latin preloaded.

shadows.name: window-lift
shadows.purpose: The window at rest (light). The only lift in the system.

shadows.name: window-lift-dark
shadows.purpose: The window at rest (dark); the first layer is a faint white edge.

shadows.name: drag-ring
shadows.purpose: The window while files are dragged over the page.

shadows.name: tooltip-float
shadows.purpose: The seal tooltip. --shadow-rgb is 30 51 44 in light, 0 0 0 in dark.

shadows.name: inset-edge
shadows.purpose: Edges of thumbnails and item tables; --leak-line on the count pill and reveals panel, --clean-line on the verified panel. Never a lift.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Expo ease-out for every transition and the seal engraving (--ease).

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Every state change: hover, disclosure (grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr), switch, chevron, drag feedback (--fast).

motion.name: sweep
motion.purpose: A 1px teal gradient line travelling under a scanning or cleaning row.

motion.name: engrave
motion.purpose: Seal strokes draw in (pathLength 1, dash offset 1 to 0), outer ring inward, once per newly cleaned file.

motion.name: tooltip-enter
motion.purpose: The seal tooltip appearing on hover or focus.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; the sweep becomes a static teal line at 0.5 opacity and seals appear finished.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: one-column options and switches, two-line rows with status under the name, full-width footer actions with the plate first.

breakpoints.name: tiny
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: 'Local only' and 'Options' labels visually hidden; icons remain.

breakpoints.name: hover
breakpoints.purpose: All hover styles are gated behind this media query.

breakpoints.name: forced-colors
breakpoints.purpose: 1px CanvasText outlines on fills and inset edges; switches in Canvas, CanvasText, Highlight.

layers: outer band: n1 paths r = 39.5 + a1·sin(k1·t + ph) + 0.6·sin(wob·t), ph = p1 + jπ/n1 (hair) — the structure check
inner rosette: n2 paths r = 20 + a2·cos(k2·t + ph), ph = p2 + 2jπ/(k2·n2) (hair) — the pixel check
centre: check mark M42.5 50.5 l5 5 10-11 (bold) when verified, else a r=3 dot (line) for brand marks

narrative.overview:
imgstrip is one small, exact window set on a cool mineral ground: an instrument that fits in a glance. A single panel carries the whole tool, from the drop well to the verified files, and nothing sits outside it except a version line and the honest list of what cleaning can't do. The world turns down the category's default of a page-wide dashed drop zone under a cloud-upload icon. Dropping a file shows as a quiet teal ring on the window and a small ink pill near the bottom of the viewport.

Type is a newsroom grotesk at small sizes, green-black ink on near-white, with parts separated by hairlines and tonal fills rather than boxes and shadows. Colour is held back for meaning. Vermilion is what a file gives away, green is what has been verified clean, amber is what did not go to plan, and teal is the instrument itself (focus, the scan sweep, the drag ring). Every state has exactly one reversed ink plate, and it is the next action. Density is packed but legible: 56px bar, rows of at least 60px, 36px controls.

The signature is the engraved seal: a guilloché rosette computed from the clean file's SHA-256, so the same file always earns the same seal. It is drawn stroke by stroke when verification passes. Drawn from a fixed hash and without its check mark, it is also the brand mark. Theme follows the operating system with no toggle; the dark world is a deep ink-green, not a grey.
keyCharacteristics: One centred window, at most 680px wide, on a tinted ground; no page chrome.
One family (Schibsted Grotesk) for every word, 12px to 18px; system mono only for real values.
Meaning-only colour: vermilion reveals, green verifies, amber warns, teal instruments.
One reversed ink plate per state; no plate before files exist.
Flat inside, one lift outside: hairlines and tonal fills inside the window, a soft layered shadow under it.
A hash-engraved guilloché seal as the single signature move.
Light and dark as exact token pairs following `prefers-color-scheme`.

rules.name: The Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks only what a file reveals; green marks only verified-clean output. Neither colour decorates anything else, and neither appears in chrome, buttons or the brand mark.

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: Each state carries exactly one reversed ink plate: the next action (Clean N images, Download, or Save while the folder row is open, when the footer action steps down to secondary). The empty state has no plate at all.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a light and dark pair under one custom property name; dark mode redefines `:root` under `prefers-color-scheme: dark` and nothing else. A new colour is not done until both halves exist.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Schibsted Grotesk sets every word, from the wordmark to the smallest hint. Weight and the three ink steps carry hierarchy; nothing goes above 18px and no second family appears.

rules.name: The Real Values Rule
rules.body: System mono appears only for actual values a file carries or the engine produces: metadata fields, coordinates, byte counts, hashes, folder paths, file suffixes. Labels and prose stay in the grotesk.

rules.name: The Instrument Figures Rule
rules.body: Counts use tabular figures: the row's count pill, the list count, group counts and the footer summary. File sizes and dimensions stay proportional, because this face's tabular period is too wide.

rules.name: The Glance Width Rule
rules.body: The window never grows past 680px, whatever the viewport. More files make it taller, never wider.

rules.name: The Name Column Rule
rules.body: Everything inside an open row's detail starts on the file-name column (56px: a 4px row inset, the 40px thumbnail and a 12px gap), so the thumbnail column stays clear.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the window lifts off the ground. Nothing inside the window casts a shadow; if a part needs separating, use a hairline or a tonal fill.

rules.name: The Earned Seal Rule
rules.body: A seal with a check mark is drawn only for a file that passed both checks. Partial, payload-kept and refused results show no seal. The check-less seal from the fixed hash is the brand mark (bar, empty well, access gate, favicon) and is never drawn in green.

rules.name: The 180 Rule
rules.body: Every state change takes 180ms on the expo ease-out. Longer motion is reserved for work in progress (the sweep) and proof (the seal).

dos: **Do** keep the whole tool in one centred window no wider than 680px (`min(680px, 100% - 32px)`), on the mineral ground.
**Do** separate parts inside the window with 1px hairlines, tonal fills and 1px inset edges.
**Do** give every interactive element a visible `:focus-visible` ring: 2px instrument teal at a 2px offset (zero on fields, inset 2px on row heads).
**Do** keep the plate focusable while it waits or works: `aria-disabled="true"`, never `disabled`.
**Do** gate hover styles behind `(hover: hover)`, and zero all motion under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
**Do** give each component that relies on fills or inset edges a forced-colours fallback (a 1px CanvasText outline; switches in Canvas, CanvasText and Highlight).
**Do** add every new colour as a light and dark pair under the same custom property.
donts: **Don't** use vermilion or green for anything except what a file reveals and what has been verified clean.
**Don't** put a second reversed plate in a state, and don't show a plate before any file exists.
**Don't** set type above 18px or in a second family, and don't use mono for labels or prose.
**Don't** draw a checked seal for a file that did not pass both checks, and don't tint the brand mark green.
**Don't** cast shadows inside the window; only the window, the seal tooltip and the drop pill float.
**Don't** turn the drop well into a page-wide dashed zone with an upload icon; drag feedback is the teal ring, the well's teal border and the drop pill.
